applicabilityBasis.summary: USD3 is a yield-accruing decentralized token folio. Its holder returns are realized through NAV appreciation, and permissionless redemption returns a proportional on-chain collateral basket. Current protocol data identifies a yield DTF at the tracked Ethereum contract with price above $1. No legal obligor promising fixed-dollar monetary-value redemption was identified.

genius.notes: Reviewed October 7, 2026. The catalog fiat-cash archetype and USD label do not describe the current value-accruing mechanics. The 2024 RFC describes an initial $1 unit and currency ambitions; the current USD3 report expressly states that holder yield is realized through NAV appreciation. Reserve live data identifies the tracked Ethereum address 0x0d86883FAf4FfD7aEb116390af37746F45b6f378 as a yield DTF with Savings USDS, Aave USDC, Compound USDC and Steakhouse USDC collateral. Redemption returns digital-asset collateral rather than an issuer obligation for a fixed monetary amount. This follows the yield-accruing-share rubric; it does not assert a securities exemption or a regulator classification. Reserve terms identify ABC Labs, LLC as the website provider and disclaim control, issuance and custody of third-party DTFs. No legal issuerEntity is assigned on that website-provider fact. Black Manta offers a separate Luxembourg performance-linked note with ISIN LU3087210947 referencing USD3; its security issuer and licenses must not be attributed to the native USD3 token. eUSD sibling sidecar was read: its stable unit and payment use case differ from USD3 NAV appreciation.
